title: release leaves the item file modified and uncommitted, so begin of an item whose touches overlap the released claim still refuses until a hand set --commit and sync push
goal: release takes --commit and --trailer as claim does (bl_base.COMMITS names release) and, with --commit, commits the item file it wrote alone with a chore(backlog) release subject and KB-Work naming the item; without --commit it still only writes the file and says the item file is uncommitted and a begin of an item whose touches overlap waits for the commit and push

run:
import shutil, subprocess as s, sys, tempfile, pathlib as P
t = P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); c = t / "clone"; c.mkdir()
shutil.copytree("_tools", c / "_tools", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "test_*"))
shutil.copy("backlog.json", c / "backlog.json")
(c / "kb/_self/backlog").mkdir(parents=True)
f = c / "kb/_self/backlog/ST-aaaaaaaa.json"
f.write_text('{"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "x", "status": "doing", "claimed_by": "t"}\n')
def g(*a): return s.run(["git", *a], cwd=c, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("config", "user.email", "a@b.c"); g("config", "user.name", "t"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
p = s.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "release", "ST-aaaaaaaa", "--commit"], cwd=c, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(p.returncode, p.stdout[-300:], p.stderr[-300:])
dirty = g("status", "--porcelain", "--", "kb/_self/backlog").strip()
last = g("log", "-1", "--format=%s%n%b").strip()
print("dirty:", repr(dirty)); print("last:", last)
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode == 0 and not dirty and "release" in last and "ST-aaaaaaaa" in last else 1)
